baseline: US national = 1.00 (BLS OEWS US national annual median wage, same release as metro values). Keystone currently applies a single Texas multiplier 0.95 to the national baseline.
method: Factor = 0.40*L + 0.60*M, rounded to 2 decimals. L = weighted mean of (metro annual median wage / US national annual median wage) for SOC 47-2031 Carpenters (0.30), 47-2111 Electricians (0.20), 47-2152 Plumbers/Pipefitters/Steamfitters (0.20), 47-2061 Construction Laborers (0.20), 49-9021 HVAC Mechanics/Installers (0.10), from BLS OEWS; weights renormalised over occupations available for the MSA. M = materials index, 1.00 for all Texas metros (no public citable reason to adjust); qualitative materials notes per MSA. THIS RUN IS PROVISIONAL: only carpenters (47-2031) could be retrieved, so L = carpenter ratio alone (weight renormalised to 1.00).
release: BLS OEWS May 2024 (published 2025) via O*NET OnLine Texas local-wages page. May 2025 OEWS was published 2026-05-15 (USDL-26-0725) but its metro tables could not be reached; May 2025 national medians recorded for reference only.
